component: LOS (line of sight); negative = away from satellite = subsidence
source: NISAR L2 GUNW (PROVISIONAL, CRID P05023) via ASF DAAC, track 7 descending frame 69; https://nisar-docs.asf.alaska.edu/gunw
notes: Cumulative LOS displacement relative to 2025-10-17, sum of 6 consecutive pairs (2025-10-17_2025-10-29, 2025-10-29_2025-11-22, 2025-11-22_2025-12-04, 2025-12-04_2025-12-16, 2025-12-16_2025-12-28, 2025-12-28_2026-01-09). Phase to cm with -lambda/(4*pi), lambda from each file's centerFrequency. Masks: coherence >= 0.3, connectedComponents != 0, isolated patches < 200 px (1.3 km2) removed (unwrapping-error guard), pixels deviating > lambda/4 (half a phase cycle) from their 720 m tile median removed, |pair| > 15.0 cm removed; pixel shown only if valid in every pair. All pairs referenced to the same window at 33.7271E 37.7626N. The ionosphere phase screen shipped in each GUNW was subtracted. A best-fit plane was removed from each pair (long-wavelength atmospheric residual; this can also remove part of any valley-wide tilt). Troposphere and solid-earth-tide layers were NOT applied; residual atmospheric noise of a few cm per pair is expected. chain gap 2026-01-09 -> 2026-06-26: stopped at 2026-01-09
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team. This series MIXES provisional products with pre-calibration BETA products (dates before 2026-06-17); treat amplitudes before that date with extra caution.
